input.summary: Extend the Auction Platform licence to Customer's Affiliates and contractors, remove at-will revocability, and confirm transfer to a successor.
input.comment: [Playbook] We extended the licence to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf and removed the at-will revocation right, so the licence ends only on termination of the Agreement under paragraph 4, together with transfer to a permitted successor. Our playbook requires affiliate/contractor coverage and a licence that is not revocable at Kubient's discretion; if helpful, we can instead cover Affiliates on written notice to Kubient.

ops.oldText: Kubient hereby grants to Customer a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-assignable, without right of sublicense, revocable license to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform as hosted by Kubient, for the purpose of serving Inventory at Target Demand
ops.newText: Kubient hereby grants to Customer, its Affiliates and contractors acting on Customer's behalf a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive license, transferable to a successor in accordance with the assignment provisions of this Agreement and revocable only upon expiration or termination of this Agreement in accordance with paragraph 4, to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform as hosted by Kubient, for the purpose of serving Inventory at Target Demand
